title: UI风格#38 - Art Nouveau Organic (新艺术有机)
description: 创建第38种UI风格：新艺术有机风格 - 曲线之美、藤蔓纹样、自然生长。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planAL.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Nouveau style When color palette Then features sage greens, muted golds, cream, antique bronze
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#8FBC8F (灰绿), #D4AF37 (金), #FAF0E6 (米白), #CD853F (古铜), #2F4F4F (深海蓝)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Nouveau style When typography Then uses elegant art fonts: Cormorant, libre baskerville, or EB Garamond
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Cormorant (标题), libre baskerville (正文), EB Garamond (装饰)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Nouveau style When layout Then organic curves, vine patterns, nature-inspired composition
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：有机曲线、藤蔓纹样、自然生长构图、百合装饰

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Nouveau style When UI elements Then whiplash curves, floral ornaments, stained glass effects
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：鞭线曲线、花卉装饰、彩色玻璃效果、自然过渡

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Nouveau UI When functional Then includes nature chat, garden agents, bloom stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：自然聊天、花园代理、绽放统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Nouveau UI When copy Then uses romantic nature: 'Bloom', 'Flourish', 'Nature', 'Grace'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'BLOOM. FLOURISH. GRACE.'、按钮'SEND'→'BLOOM'、'SUBMIT'→'FLOURISH'
